title: Mondrian Piano
prompt:
TrackType: Instrument. Solo acoustic piano only, unaccompanied. Energetic intricate chamber-jazz boogie-woogie piano. A light, steady eight-to-the-bar left-hand ostinato on C and G supports a busy mosaic of short right-hand figures. Right hand plays frequent eighth-note cells and brief sixteenth-note bursts, clipped repeated notes, angular register jumps, displaced accents and syncopated answers. Mostly active playing with only tiny eighth-note or quarter-note gaps, never long empty passages. Recombine two-to-five-note fragments every bar. Crisp attacks and short natural decays, moderate bass and controlled comfortable dynamics. Rhythmic intricacy without long scalar runs or heavy block chords. No drums, trumpet, vibraphone, strings, pads or accompanying instruments.

120 BPM, 4/4, eight bars, exactly 16 seconds. A fixed C tonal center using C, E, G and A with occasional D passing notes, no chord progression or modulation. Inspired by the intricate small colored blocks and interlocking lines of Piet Mondrian's Victory Boogie Woogie. Steady underlying pulse and lightly swung phrasing, precise articulation, dry intimate acoustic recording. Begin immediately in the established groove on the first downbeat. Maintain consistent activity throughout. No intro, outro, fade, final cadence, dramatic build or vocals. A repeating instrumental part intended to be layered with other instruments.
